definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {国際連合|こくさいれんごう}. The international organization established in 1945 to promote peace, security, and cooperation among nations.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}の{総会|そうかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A UN General Assembly session was held.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{国連|こくれん}の{加盟国|かめいこく}だ。
examples.english: Japan is a member state of the United Nations.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}{安全保障理事会|あんぜんほしょうりじかい}が{緊急|きんきゅう}{会合|かいごう}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: The UN Security Council held an emergency meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of {国際連合|こくさいれんごう}. {国連|こくれん} is the standard form used in news and everyday conversation. The full form {国際連合|こくさいれんごう} appears mainly in formal documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国連|こくれん}{総会|そうかい}: UN General Assembly
- {国連|こくれん}{安保理|あんぽり}: UN Security Council (abbreviated)
- {国連|こくれん}{事務総長|じむそうちょう}: UN Secretary-General
- {国連|こくれん}{加盟国|かめいこく}: UN member state
- {国連|こくれん}{平和|へいわ}{維持|いじ}{活動|かつどう}: UN peacekeeping operations (PKO)
